title: “Behind the Meme: Human Lives”
paragraphs: People in Greenland are mocking ‘American culture’ by imitating scenes linked to fentanyl use — satirical protest that’s gone viral online. Behind the funny video, there’s a real human tragedy of addiction and brokenness that can’t just be a meme. As followers of Christ, let’s not laugh at suffering; let’s pray for the afflicted. Jesus wept with those in pain (John 11:35), and He calls us to see people, not just pixels. Compassion speaks louder than satire.
